subject: [Project Nimbus] Decision: v1 API ships with diagnostics, arch review 7/10
body:
Team,

Wrapping up Nimbus decisions before window close:

1. v1 ships as "automatic and safe": build_asvi_surrogate_posterior behind our paved-path API, with Tereza's structure-gap diagnostic on by default. The 7-of-9 Inference Gym result plus the warning story got a strong reception from Hana.
2. Nadia confirmed internal-API scope means architecture review only, no full LRB. We're booked for 7/10.
3. Cross-plate correlation handling is officially out of scope for v1; Umar writes it up as a Q3 research item.

Rosa - please make sure the API docs use the Nimbus name consistently, a couple of drafts still say "the ASVI project" and it confuses the planning tooling.

Thanks all - clean, low-drama execution.

Anders
